scripts.-- 说明: 本地命令统一走 scripts/wrangler-local.mjs，它把 workerd 临时目录固定到仓库内，否则 wrangler 会启动失败
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler-local.mjs d1 migrations apply wy-zfq-config-hub --local
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-d1-seed.mjs && node scripts/wrangler-local.mjs d1 execute wy-zfq-config-hub --local --file seeds/0002_seed_schemes.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply wy-zfq-config-hub --remote
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/build-d1-seed.mjs && npx wrangler d1 execute wy-zfq-config-hub --remote --file seeds/0002_seed_schemes.sql
